query:
UPDATE plugin_staged_items SET
             status = $3::text::plugin_staged_status,
             review_note = $4,
             reviewed_by = $5,
             reviewed_at = $6,
             adopted_install_id = COALESCE($7, adopted_install_id),
             adopted_skill_id = COALESCE($8, adopted_skill_id),
             updated_at = now()
           WHERE org_id = $1 AND id = $2
